subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

Footballers run from one corner of the field __to other__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **to another**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace '**other**' with '**another**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• We use **"each other"** and **"one another"** to show that each person in a group of two or more people does something to the others.
